### Lost Wonderers Thoughts:

I spend an hour raading 
"Postmoden Quantummechanics" [@heller1993postmodern].

Semiclassical approximation of quantum amplitudes have a *universal* form and is given by
$$\psi(x)=\sum_n \sqrt{P_n(x)} \,\exp\Big\{i \varphi_n(x)/\hbar\Big\},$$
with

- $\varphi_n(x)$ – classical action along the $n^\text{th}$ path reaching $x$

- $P_n(x)$ – classical probability
